verdict.rationale: Asana is a SaaS work-management product with AI features, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a setting, policy, or contractual commitment that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The agent governance controls (scoped permissions, data access) and the 'shared memory' learning feature are adjacent capabilities and do not amount to a training opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
